name: Accel Entertainment, Inc.
summary:
Accel Entertainment (ACEL) reported earnings of $0.15 per share on revenue of $368.13 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.18 per share on revenue of $354.71 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 16.67% while revenue grew 9.59% on a year-over-year basis.

Accel is a leading distributed gaming operator in the United States on an Adjusted EBITDA basis, and a preferred partner for local business owners in the Illinois market.
subject: Accel Entertainment Missed Consensus Estimates
